_about: Public-domain Michael Ferrebee Sadler (1819-1895), Anglican prebendary and commentator, for the Word Hoard: The Second Adam and the New Birth, Emmanuel, The Church Teacher's Manual, The Communicant's Manual, The Lost Gospel, Church Doctrine Bible Truth, and his commentaries on the Gospels, Romans, Corinthians, the Pauline epistles, Hebrews, the General Epistles and the Revelation. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 84 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
